releaseNotes: v1.8.0: Radio seen, no events. A Zigbee or Z-Wave device the hub radio still hears, but that has stopped sending events for your Offline threshold, now shows Poor with a note instead of Good. Only devices that normally report regularly are checked, so quiet devices are unaffected. v1.7.5: New Info logging toggle at the bottom of the main page, on by default. Turn it off to quiet scan and verification lines. Warnings and errors still log. v1.7.4: Light mode for the web portal. Pick Dark, Light or Follow device under Web portal in the app, or tap the new ◐ button on the portal itself, which each browser remembers. Dark stays the default. No Done needed. v1.7.3: Dark mode. The app follows the hub's light or dark theme (Hubitat 2.5.3+) and keeps its current look on older firmware. The web portal keeps its own dark theme. No changes to monitoring.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Device Health Monitor
apps.description: Learns each device's normal check-in pattern and flags devices that go quiet, with verification, locations, snooze, and a live web portal.
